conventions.picture: Proposition S stable picture; Z = Sym^2+Sym^3+Sym^4 of V'^*, V' = C^col
conventions.letters: Q_d in Sym^d V', T_d symmetric with f_d(s) = sum T_d[i_1..i_d] s_{i_1}..s_{i_d}
conventions.bracket: (a_d,b_d,c_d,z_d): copies of Q_d in eps1 only / eps2 only / both / neither

conventions.value: c!.[y^c] det BigM(y) . prod s_d^{z_d}; see module docstring
conventions.values_are: exact residues mod p of the bracket values at the stored integer points; no transform, no normalisation, no scaling applied
conventions.independence: no code, data structure or mechanism shared with s69/s74/s79

lifting: rational symmetric tensors with denominators dividing d(d-1); house primes are units; brackets are epsilon contractions over Q
